entities.summary: Major general Jaroslav Čihák was a Czech military commander. He was an army officer in the Austro-Hungarian Army from 1914, Russian legionary from 1916, and later Brigadier General/Chief of Staff of the Ministry of National Defence for the Czechoslovak government-in-exile.

entities.summary: Major general Jaroslav Čihák was a Czech military commander. He was an army officer in the Austro-Hungarian Army from 1914, Russian legionary from 1916, and later Brigadier General/Chief of Staff of the Ministry of National Defence for the Czechoslovak government-in-exile.
